'''Canldives''', officially the '''Republic of Canldives''', and historically known as the [[Caldiev Islands]], is an archipelagic country in [[North Massir]], located in the southern [[Vihsanna Ocean]]. [[Taval]] is located to the north, and over ___ from the [[Massir|Massiran]] continent's mainland. Candives' chain of 26 atolls and 60 islands stretches from [[Ihppohu Atoll]] in the north to [[Adu Atoll]] in the south.

Cyclades is the fifth-smallest country in [[Massir]]. Its land area is only 5,418 square kilometers (2,092 sq mi). With a population of [[List of countries and dependencies by population|754,000 in the]] 1764 census, it is the second least populous country in Massir and the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|third-smallest country by area]], but also one of the most [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|densely populated countries]]. 

[[Maranthulo]] is the capital and the most populated city, traditionally called the "King's Island", where the ancient royal dynasties ruled from its central location. Canldives has been inhabited for over 4,500 years. Documented contact with the outside world began around the 700s when [[Taval|Tavalan travelers]] began visiting the islands. In the 9th century, partly due to the importance of the Tavalan and [[Dahe|Dahen]] as traders in the [[Vihsanna Ocean]], ____ reached the [[Caldiev Islands]]. Canldives was soon consolidated as an integral port of the [[Alqiran Empire]], developing strong commercial and cultural ties with [[Taval]]. From the mid-13th century, the increasing influence of [[Ayuman colonial powers]], with Canldives, made Canldives a flourishing trade hub, which became a [[dominion in 1470]]. Independence from the [[Taval]] came in 1620, and a [[wikipedia:Presidential_republic|presidential republic]] was established in 1621. The ensuing decades have seen political stability, efforts at democratic reform, and environmental challenges posed by [[wikipedia:Climate_change|climate change]] and rising sea levels. Canldives became a founding member of the [[Massiran Association for Regional Cooperation|Massiran Association for Regional Cooperation (MARC)]].

[[wikipedia:Fishing|Fishing]] has historically been the dominant economic activity and remains the second-largest sector, behind the rapidly growing [[wikipedia:Tourism|tourism industry]]. Canldives rates "very high" on the [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|Krali Total Development Index]], with a per capita income significantly higher than that of other nations. The [[Global Trade Union]] classifies Canldives as having an [[wikipedia:Developing_country|upper-middle income economy]].
